test_title: PYST 10: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: There are six persons, M, N, P, Q, R and S, in a family. S is the paternal grandmother of M. P is the sister of R. N is the father of P. M is the only son of Q and R. N does not have any married daughter. How is M related to N?
solution:
Family Chart :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e70d0728e8a5dd5f196bbe20b73ec215e5eb6436edd37e5a2a585eaa6a838c1d.png] 

1) P is the sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2337dd0d8b6ce45ca87e4551f951bdfb850ea4cfd8bb2556e26f76d96151ca17.png] 

2) N is the father of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a3788fcd8b854579c8cd67e6e55d97788d1b7f2db1580fea3f5ac93aad3116c.png] 

3) N does not have any married daughter.

4) M is the only son of Q and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d01d8b774aa1ec688c3d8b48405d329daa10b8f98b7a74bff73abcb4529bdb9.png] 

5) S is the paternal grandmother of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fec66b28dbaccd63c85fa427d4d7761f0aed40ee368d3d27a28bf819a6b87186.png] 

∴ Here, M is 'grandson' of N.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Grandson".**
